title: Vilay (community health worker, Village 04, Lao PDR)
description: Persona for J2: the community health worker of catchment Village 04 in Lao PDR (Country B). Works offline for weeks at a time on an Android phone (OHS app, community configuration) and syncs when she reaches the health center. Can register a child and refer, but cannot decide whether a foreign record is genuine. Fictional.

persona.name: Vilay
persona.goal: Make sure no newborn in her village is missed, even with no signal.
needs: Tools that work offline for weeks
A fast way to capture foreign cards
A clear next step to hand the family
frustrations: Can't confirm whether a foreign card is genuine
Paperwork that duplicates what the clinic does
